mechanism_narrative: A low level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.5% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, which triggers risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%, or the Rank IC between UNRATE and 20-day returns is below -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is rising (above its 3-month moving average) and housing starts (HOUST) is falling (below its 3-month moving average), it signals a weakening demand environment despite stable supply, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 3mo_avg and HOUST < 3mo_avg, or the Rank IC between the interaction signal and 20-day returns is below -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%), the Federal Reserve's policy rate hikes compress equity valuations through higher discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.0%, or the Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns is above 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of consumer spending (measured by RSAFS) indicates strong economic activity, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS is above its 12-month average, or the Rank IC between RSAFS and 5-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1000.0 thousand units signals a weakening housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1000.0, or the Rank IC between HOUST and 20-day returns is above 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 0.5% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.5%, it signals a recessionary monetary policy response to a weak labor market, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and UNRATE > 5.5%, or the Rank IC between the interaction signal and 20-day returns is below -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strong manufacturing output, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is above its 12-month average, or the Rank IC between INDPRO and 60-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
